slides.title: Your October home check
slides.sub: Six quick jobs that save you a cold night, a big bill, or a scare. No one else is going to remind you, so here you go.

slides.title: Swap the furnace filter
slides.body: A clogged filter makes the heat work harder and cost more. Write the size on the side of the unit so next time takes two minutes.

slides.title: Test smoke and CO alarms
slides.body: Press the test button on every one. If you live alone, these are the only thing that will wake you up.

slides.title: Find your water shut-off
slides.body: Locate the main valve now, not when a pipe bursts. Make sure it turns and you can reach it.

slides.title: Then knock these out
items: Clean the dryer lint trap and vent
Stock a flashlight and fresh batteries
slides.note: Put a reminder on your calendar to do this again in spring.

slides.title: Save this for your weekend.
slides.body: Send it to a friend who runs a home on their own. Home reminders, bill reminders and safety check-ins live at singles-life.app
